answer: Each claim must sail through the inlet into the haven carrying a sail woven only from its own verified jobs, and pay 70 POA burned to enter. At the inlet mouth the sail must rise to its zenith - peers measure its height against the public ledger line that wove it, and only a sail reaching the zenith passes. A copied sail sags below the zenith, the inlet shuts, and the claim sinks with its 70 POA burned. Cost rises with the square of claims from one operator, so 10 clones cost 26,950 POA; a sail is cut for one ledger line and cannot be lent across identities.
